Title: Public Preview: Confidential computing for Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server

Body.Content:
Announcing support for confidential computing in Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server. With confidential computing enabled, you can enhance the security of sensitive and regulated data, helping mitigate unwanted data access by cloud providers, administrators, or external users. Azure confidential computing encrypts data in hardware-based trusted execution environments (TEEs), processing data only when the cloud environment has been verified.

Learn more.
